checks: token-only colors and verified palette switch

purpose: Show rate limiting as tokens in a bucket and requests evaluated in order.
use_when: Quotas, throttling, why a burst is denied while a steady rate passes.
not_when: Queues (requests here are denied, not delayed) or billing budgets (use expansion:budget).
limits: Outcomes are computed in order from the current tokens without refill; the graphic states this.
